title: Finality and the binding effect of judgments
shortTitle: Finality and the binding effect of judgments
summary: Finality limits repeated litigation after a court has entered a judgment. The course encounters it in jurisdictional challenges, class representation, and the protection of absent persons.
notes: This semester map includes the portions of finality discussed in assigned chapters.

sections.Meaning: Finality limits repeated litigation after a court has entered a judgment. The course encounters it in jurisdictional challenges, class representation, and the protection of absent persons.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify what was decided, who was a party or adequately represented, whether the issue was previously litigated, and whether the challenge is direct or collateral. Keep those questions separate from whether the original decision was correct.
